connect: Connect a gamepad via USB or Bluetooth, then press any button on it.
connectionHelp: Still waiting? Keep this tab active and check that your device recognizes the gamepad.
unavailableHelp: Open this page directly in an up-to-date browser and try again.

checkInterrupted: Check stopped. Keep this tab open and try again.
